verdict.rationale: Docs show performance-related controls (per-provider timeouts for fast failover, sort-by-performance metric, automatic caching) that imply attention to latency, but there is no direct benchmark or explicit claim quantifying the gateway's own added latency overhead. Missing for 10: published latency benchmarks or first-party/independent measurements showing the gateway adds minimal overhead versus direct provider calls, and no community corroboration of low added latency.
